# Marvel Labs — Autonomous Microfactory Trailers

Marvel Labs Inc. develops autonomous microfactories. https://marvellabs.shop/ is its trailer product and reservation site; https://marvellabs.com/ is the corporate site. The founder is Jake Miller. Official organization identity: https://marvellabs.com/#organization. The company focus is physical AI and manufacturing; this website does not offer Shopware plugins or e-commerce development services.

## Current offer and limits
Reservations are open through Shopify for a one-time $100 USD refundable deposit. This is not the trailer price or a monthly lease fee. Shopify confirms successful payment; no remaining balance is charged automatically. Contact jaxon@marvellabs.com with the Shopify order number to change or cancel a reservation.

Preview Buy prices: 16 ft $44,999; 20 ft $49,999. Proposed operator shares are 75% for Buy and 25% for Lease, applying to the agreed profit from products sold, not the selling price or products merely produced. The monthly lease fee is $0, confirmed by the owner on November 8, 2026; the refundable $100 reservation deposit is separate. A $0 lease fee does not eliminate operating costs. Lease duration, operating obligations and final profit calculations are confirmed in the written agreement.

Target delivery: Spring 2027, not guaranteed; timing is confirmed separately. Nominal footprints: 16 ft × 8.5 ft and 20 ft × 8.5 ft. Both trailers are 7.5 ft high. Width and height are identical; only the length differs. Both have a 6 ft 2½ in factory layout, with 9 ft 9½ in and 13 ft 9½ in rear cargo respectively. Usable clearances, weights, payload and towing requirements are pending.

Suitable collected grass is the development focus; validated feedstock limits, power, runtime, output, reliability and operating costs have not been published. Leaves and food waste are not validated inputs in the published material. Films and product images illustrate the intended design and workflow. App data is illustrative. The $300 example assumes 20 sales at an illustrative $15 gross operator earnings each, before operator expenses; it is not measured output, a forecast, or a plan-specific return.

## Technology terminology
The trailer concept connects physical AI, autonomous microfactories, mobile manufacturing and distributed manufacturing. Suitable collected grass is the biomass-upcycling development focus; circular manufacturing is an intended approach, not a quantified environmental result. Robotics, automation and computer vision are explained on the technology page; no complete validated trailer specification is implied. The website assistant answers questions about the product and business offer. It does not operate machinery, access live trailer cameras or complete payments. A conversational assistant does not establish autonomous factory performance. Marvel Crew app data is illustrative.

This file is a navigation aid, not a special search-ranking requirement. The linked public pages and current policies are authoritative.
